Cost: 500eb
Vendor: Sanroo (Corp)

An Exotic shotgun with a Power Rebuild. Holds 5 rounds and is incompatible with any extended/drum magizine mods. Any mixture of rounds can be loaded into the gun and fired in any order. Despite being an exotic weapon it is capable of firing non-standard ammunition. Requires 2 Actions to reload. The shotgun is a break action with five barrels arranged to look like a paw print.

Foundry notes:

  • The sheet gives no damage, ROF, or hands, so it uses the core Shotgun's (5d6 slug or 3d6 shells, ROF 1, two-handed) with 5 rounds. Its Power Rebuild is not applied; install Corgo's 77 Power Rebuild if you use it.
  • Exotic, but it fires normal shotgun ammunition. Reloading takes 2 Actions.

From Bontari Homebrew Cyberpunk Items by Bontari (Weapons).
